§6Circuits§f

§aYour first circuit board. Welcome to the electrical age.§f

The §bAnalog Circuit Board§f is the entry-level circuit made at the §bSoldering Station§f. You need it for the chemical plant, arc furnace, and most mid-game machines. It's the thing that unlocks everything electrical.

Check JEI at the soldering station for the recipe. Expect capacitors, vacuum tubes, PCBs, lead wires, and about §e2 kHE/s§f for 5 seconds. Not expensive per board, but you'll need a lot of them as you scale up.

§ePS:§f Automate capacitor and PCB production early. Higher circuit tiers eat them by the stack, and hand-crafting gets old fast.
